description: Adapt existing NVENC encoder backend for Windows. Replace DMA-buf input with ID3D11Texture2D input via NV_ENC_REGISTER_RESOURCE with NV_ENC_INPUT_RESOURCE_TYPE_DIRECTX. Zero-copy from DXGI capture to NVENC — frames never leave the GPU. Handle D3D11 device creation, texture format negotiation (BGRA→NV12 via NVENC's built-in CSC), and proper resource lifecycle. Target: < 2ms encode latency for 1080p60.
title: NVENC Direct3D11 interop path
